channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Kanye West | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Kanye West from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Ajay Mitchell on Kanye West
item.description:
“Every time something’s going on, I’m just like, ‘What would he say? What would he think?’”

Ajay Mitchell on Kanye West, May 7, 2026. Source: New York Times.

item.title: Kevin Durant on Michael Jordan, Kanye West
item.description:
“From a Basquiat to a Dr. Dre to a Michael Jordan to a Jay Electronica. All types of people that I feel are great at what they do. Elon Musk, guys like that who really spent a lot of time thinking. Kanye West. I just try to see what their perspective was and try to make it my own and do my own thing.”

Kevin Durant on Michael Jordan, Kanye West, Oct 28, 2020. Source: Forbes.com.
